page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture compute-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 2.0 GB per core ratio. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate moderate single-core capabilities but lower multi-core scaling. The single-core Geekbench score of 1569.0 and stress-ng single-core CPU performance of 1881.08 fall into the average tier. However, multi-core metrics, such as the Geekbench multi-core score of 3355.0 and stress-ng multi-core performance of 3880.59, are positioned in the weaker tier. Memory bandwidth is also relatively constrained, with large block read and write speeds measured at 28.84 GB/sec and 23.66 GB/sec respectively.

Given its compute-focused vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.c7t.xlarge is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring dedicated CPU cycles without massive memory footprints. It is suitable for lightweight web serving, single-threaded batch processing, text processing, and basic software compilation. It is less optimal for memory-intensive databases, heavy multi-threaded workloads, or high-throughput static web serving due to its lower multi-core and memory bandwidth benchmark results.
